# WP2-c: comparison of detection methods, robustness and ablations

All numbers recomputed here from saved per-record alarms. Benign records: more than 60 s from any attack window. 01-Basic: 1 Hz records. 02-Semiurban: every 5th record (5 s). Mean delay: first alarm after attack start, averaged over detected process-attack instances (arp-spoof excluded per owner decision 1).

## 01-Basic (CIGRE MV, 15 buses, fully observed)

| method | CFC | drift-off | industroyer | arp-spoof (excl.) | mean delay s (process attacks) | false alarms per benign record | false alarm episodes per benign hour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Classic residual test (D1, full power flow) | 5/5 | 3/4 | 2/7 | 2/2 | 78 | 0.00059 | 0.85 |
| ML: autoencoder, raw telemetry | 5/5 | 4/4 | 7/7 | 2/2 | 1 | 0.99988 | 2.01 |
| ML: Isolation Forest, physics-informed | 0/5 | 0/4 | 0/7 | 0/2 | ⟨·⟩ | 0.00000 | 0.00 |
| ML: autoencoder, physics-informed | 4/5 | 3/4 | 2/7 | 0/2 | 92 | 0.00100 | 0.95 |
| Detectors D1 or AE (alert source) | 5/5 | 3/4 | 2/7 | 2/2 | 77 | 0.00109 | 1.06 |
| Certified library, rules active at the time (incl. learned during the same attack) | 4/5 | 4/4 | 3/7 | 0/2 | 70 | 0.00124 | 0.64 |
| Certified library only, strict (rules learned before the attack) | 4/5 | 4/4 | 2/7 | 0/2 | 102 | 0.00124 | 0.64 |
| Combined: detectors or certified library | 5/5 | 4/4 | 3/7 | 2/2 | 68 | 0.00171 | 1.06 |
